body:
Triage: parked `pm:blocked` (line in body) on objectstack-ai/objectstack#11345 — the maintainer-filed contract question (where does a derived related list's sort declaration live: field-level `relatedListSort`, inherit the child list view's `sort`, or none) is now in the decision inbox with a four-prism block. This card is the component-side consumer of whatever is ruled; contract-first, the spec/engine half decides the shape. `domain:ui`, Feature.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Unblock relay from the objectstack spec seat (session_01T9cDbY2NBiVJWYx3BpWfH2): **the block inverted — this card is now the implementation leg.** `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` in this stroke.

1. **The ruling is in** (objectstack#11345, maintainer, 2026-08-23 15:02Z): **direction 1** — derived related lists inherit the child object's default list view `sort`. **No new spec key**; field-level `relatedListSort` was explicitly not approved.
2. **Measurement (full map in the os-dev-report on objectstack#11345, comment 5388863970) puts both halves in this repo**: descriptor emit at `app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts:133-146` (re-dropped at `RecordDetailView.tsx:1955-1978` and `plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:174-188`/`683-690`); `$orderby` assembly at `plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:519-529`, fed via `renderers/record-related-list.tsx:211`. objectstack's share is already in place and needs no change: the `isDefault` expanded-list-view resolver (`spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:4111-4198`, already merged onto the child def as `obj.list` by `MetadataProvider.tsx:413-414`), the ListView sort shape (`view.zod.ts:1470-1486`), and the declared-parsed-consumed `record:related_list.sort` prop (`component.zod.ts:883-928`) — the inheritance only needs to fill it.
3. **Sketch from the measurement** (yours to refine): emit `sort` from `child.list?.sort` in `deriveRelatedLists.ts` (child def already in hand at :118); carry it at the two re-drop sites; renderer/RelatedList unchanged. ⚠️ Caveat: ListView legacy string sort is space-separated `'field desc'` (`view.zod.ts:1470`) while `normalizeSortSpec` reads `'field'`/`'-field'` (`RelatedList.tsx:258-266`) — normalize to the array form or inherit only the array arm, or `$orderby` goes out on a field literally named `seq_no desc`.
4. **Attach, don't lose**: pre-existing on this file surface — a declared `record:related_list.sort` is dropped whenever the list leaves windowed mode (windowed goes false while the client text filter is active, `RelatedList.tsx:383-389`; the client path returns rows unsorted unless a column was clicked, :731-733). Affects the authored prop today and will affect the inherited sort identically. Also #4664 (same emit point ignores `relatedListFilter`) was re-confirmed by this measurement.
5. objectstack#11345 is now `pm:blocked` on THIS card and closes when this lands and the acceptance leg passes (the 10/20/30/40 repro from its body); the 17.0.0 migration prose then becomes true as written, no prose edit needed.

> **derived related lists inherit the child object's default list view `sort`. NO new spec key**; field-level `relatedListSort` was explicitly **not** approved.

⭐ **The block inverted: this card is now the implementation leg, and objectstack#11345 is `pm:blocked` on THIS card.** It closes when this lands and its acceptance leg passes (the 10/20/30/40 repro in its body), and the 17.0.0 migration prose then becomes true as written — **no prose edit needed**. ⛔ Do not touch objectstack.

## The measurement is already done — use it, but re-derive before editing

From the spec seat's relay (full map in the os-dev-report on objectstack#11345, comment 5388863970):

- **Emit:** `app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts:133-146` — the child def is **already in hand at `:118`**.
- **Two re-drop sites:** `RecordDetailView.tsx:1955-1978` and `plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:174-188` / `683-690`.
- **`$orderby` assembly:** `RelatedList.tsx:519-529`, fed via `renderers/record-related-list.tsx:211` — **unchanged**.
- **objectstack's share is already in place and needs no change**: the `isDefault` expanded-list-view resolver (merged onto the child def as `obj.list` by `MetadataProvider.tsx:413-414`), the ListView sort shape, and the declared-parsed-consumed `record:related_list.sort` prop. **The inheritance only needs to fill it.**

**Sketch (yours to refine):** emit `sort` from `child.list?.sort` in `deriveRelatedLists.ts`; carry it at the two re-drop sites.

## ⚠️ The caveat that will bite, carried verbatim

> ListView **legacy string sort is space-separated `'field desc'`** while `normalizeSortSpec` reads **`'field'` / `'-field'`** (`RelatedList.tsx:258-266`) — normalize to the array form or inherit only the array arm, **or `$orderby` goes out on a field literally named `seq_no desc`**.

⛔ Do not inherit the string arm unnormalised. ✅ Whichever route you take, **pin it**: a child list view declaring the legacy string form must produce a correct `$orderby`, or be provably skipped.

## ⚠️ Attach, don't lose — a pre-existing defect on this exact surface

> a declared `record:related_list.sort` is **dropped whenever the list leaves windowed mode** (windowed goes false while the client text filter is active, `RelatedList.tsx:383-389`; the client path returns rows **unsorted** unless a column was clicked, `:731-733`). **Affects the authored prop today and will affect the inherited sort identically.**

⛔ Not yours to fix — `RelatedList.tsx` is read-only here. ✅ But **pin the interaction** so the inherited sort's disappearance under the client filter is a recorded, deliberate fact rather than a surprise, and say in the report that the inherited sort inherits this hole too.

⚠️ Also re-confirmed by that measurement: **#4664** (the same emit point ignores `relatedListFilter`). ⛔ Separate card — do not fold.

## PM mechanism assumptions — measure, do not assume

1. The relay is from 2026-08-23 and both packages moved repeatedly today (`app-shell`: #6031, #6035; `plugin-detail`: #6000, #6015, #6039). ⛔ Re-derive **all five** line references on your merge-base and report the delta.
2. ⚠️ **"Both re-drop sites" is a count to verify, not inherit.** If a third site re-drops the descriptor, inheriting at two of three re-creates this defect at smaller scale — the exact shape #6010 hit today. Search for the drop, do not trust the list.
3. **`child.list` is populated by `MetadataProvider.tsx:413-414` in objectstack's half.** ⚠️ Verify it is actually present at `deriveRelatedLists.ts:118` at the moment you read it — an async metadata arrival that lands *after* derivation would make the inheritance silently empty, and an empty inherited sort is indistinguishable from today's behaviour.

## Verification

Direction predicted **before** running: a child object with a default list view carrying `sort` must produce a derived related list whose `$orderby` reflects it; revert the emit and show the pin goes red. **Assert the `$orderby` that reaches the data source**, not the descriptor — the descriptor is three hops from the wire and two of those hops are the re-drop sites.

**Counter-probes:** (a) a child with **no** default list view sort must still produce a working related list with **no** `$orderby` — otherwise inheritance is satisfiable by inventing an order; (b) an **authored** `record:related_list.sort` must still win / behave exactly as today — ⛔ the ruling adds inheritance, it does not change precedence, and if it turns out precedence is undefined here, **stop and report**.

Prove every mutation on disk by grepping injected **and separately** removed text; ⚠️ **print the landing site**, ⚠️ **assert anchor uniqueness before writing**, and ⚠️ restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with a **cwd-independent** command (all three measured on other cards in this round).

⚠️ **Run app-shell path-filtered — whole-package vitest is ~784 s and holds the shared lock; ⛔ do not run it.** Gates by name with exit codes: `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (⚠️ hyphenated; echo the script name; distinguish the **unbuilt-closure** red from the **missing-`node_modules`** red), path-filtered vitest, eslint with merge-base delta, and — ⚠️ **new standing rule, measured on #5874 in this round** — **`pnpm check:esm-specifiers` if you add ANY new relative import to a published package**; it runs inside the `Type Check` CI job under a name that does not look like one, and a hand-derived gate set misses it.

Changeset required. Draft PR, `Fixes #5795`. ⛔ Do not mark ready, ⛔ do not enqueue, ⛔ no auto-merge — the PM lands it. Post the terminal report here (plain-text first-line marker `os-dev-report`; ⛔ avoid short angle-bracket placeholders in prose) and return it.

## PM review — **ACCEPT**, enqueued

PR **#6088** at `5d599be9c`. Gates read **once** at 16:36:30Z, armed off this run's own `started_at` (16:23:52Z, ~12½ min).

**22 checks, 19 success + 3 skipped, 0 failing, 0 still running** — read as *every check green, not the required subset*. Not a governed surface; marked ready and enqueued through the merge queue. ⛔ Nothing merged by hand.

### Two of my dispatch assumptions were wrong, and the dev measured rather than inherited

⚠️ **Five of the nine line references I relayed had drifted** (`RecordDetailView` +11, others −3..+2), and ⚠️ **I said `MetadataProvider.tsx` lives in `objectstack` — it is in this repo.** Both corrected by measurement on the merge-base. That is the third and fourth PM assumption falsified this round, which is the system working as intended: the dispatch's job is to name what I believe so it can be checked, ⛔ not to be right.

### The find the card did not name

**A third re-drop site exists** — `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:940`, into `record:reference_rail` entries — and it is **deliberately excluded** because `ReferenceRailEntrySchema` is `$strict` with no `sort` key. ✅ That is the objectui#5494 class, the same one #6066 landed on this morning, and it is **pinned as its own leg** rather than silently skipped. A silent skip here would have read as "two sites, both handled"; the pin makes the exclusion a measured fact with a reason.

### The design call, and why it is the right one

The two `sort` surfaces **share a union but mean different things by its string arm** — `ListView`'s legacy space-separated `'seq_no desc'` versus the related list's `'field'` / `'-field'`. The inherited value is normalised to the array arm **once, at the derivation**, through `@object-ui/core`'s `convertSortToQueryParams` — the repo's single definition of both dialects — ⛔ rather than by a tolerant reader downstream. ✅ A tolerant reader is how you get a third dialect; normalising at the producer is how you get one.

And the ruling was executed as ruled: **no new spec key** (objectstack#11345, maintainer 2026-08-23, direction 1). `RelatedList.tsx` and `renderers/record-related-list.tsx` are unchanged, exactly as the relay predicted.

### Reverse verification — three legs, every cell predicted in writing first

| leg | inheritSort | wire | synth |
|---|---|---|---|
| L1 remove the emit | **7 failed** / 2 passed | **3 failed** / 2 | 6 passed |
| L2 remove re-drop site 1 | 9 passed | **3 failed** / 2 | 6 passed |
| L3 remove re-drop site 2 | 9 passed | **3 failed** / 2 | **3 failed** / 3 |

⚠️ **The greens were predicted too**, which is the part that makes this a measurement rather than a fishing trip: the counter-probes assert **absence**, so a counter-probe going red would have meant it was really a second subject. Only the wire test goes red on all three legs — which is precisely why the subject is *the `$orderby` reaching `dataSource.find`*, ⛔ not the descriptor.

No rebuild leg was needed **and that was verified, not assumed**: `vitest.config.mts` aliases both packages to their `src/`, so no `dist/` stands between an edit and a run. ✅ Stating why a step is absent beats omitting it silently.

### The harness note that would otherwise have been a false green

⚠️ **The child object is queried TWICE on that page.** The tab strip's count probe (`$top:1, $count:true`) carries no ordering **by design**, so the helper selects the windowed page fetch explicitly. Without that, **every counter-probe would have passed by reading the count probe** — a green that looks identical to a correct result. ✅ Recorded in the report rather than buried in the harness.

Also right: the Related tab is opened **via the URL** (`?tab=related`, ADR-0054 C3) rather than a synthetic click, so the list self-fetches when its tab mounts — the real path, not a simulated one.

### Precedence — no stop-and-report needed, and the reason is on the record

A hand-authored page carries its own `record:related_list` node and **never enters this synthesizer** (`RecordDetailView` synthesizes only when no page is assigned); within the synthesized path the **one** producer of `related[].sort` is the inheritance, and the synthesizer is a pure carrier. An authored sort behaves exactly as before. ✅ Both facts pinned in the synth test rather than argued in prose.

### Counter-probe on the negative case

A child with **no** default list-view sort produces a working, scoped, windowed related list carrying **no `$orderby`** — key **absent**, ⛔ not present-and-empty — with `$filter` and `$top` asserted as live controls, so "nothing inherited" cannot read as "nothing fetched". An unusable sort (a number, a bare string array, an entry without `field`) is **dropped, never guessed**.

### Declared narrowing, correctly reasoned

`check:eager-closure` was not run: it refuses as a **broken gauge** without `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` from a console `vite build`, which is CI's job. ✅ Safe to leave there rather than merely unrun — the one new import edge is `deriveRelatedLists.ts → @object-ui/core`, and `app-shell/src/utils/index.ts` (the barrel re-exporting it) **already** imports `@object-ui/core`, so the edge adds nothing to that closure. That is an argument, not a shrug.

### Out of scope, and correctly not re-filed

Both adjacent defects were re-confirmed and found to be **already open** — objectui#4286 (a synthesized Reference Rail page is unpersistable: the `aside` region carries a `className` that `PageRegionSchema` refuses) and objectui#4664 (the same emit point ignores `relatedListFilter`). ✅ Searched before deciding, by keyword **and** file path; nothing duplicated.

**Downstream:** objectstack#11345 is `pm:blocked` on this card and unblocks on merge.
